title: MFAQ: a Multilingual FAQ Dataset
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical task of multilingual Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) retrieval. It introduces a new dataset and benchmarks the performance of various models (e.g., XLM-ROBERTa, TF-IDF) on this retrieval task. The evaluation metrics are technical (e.g., Mean Reciprocal Rank). The paper does not contain any component for evaluating or benchmarking the models on their understanding or generation of content related to religion, morals, or ethics.
